product.title: Norix Ironman Tank Box Property Storage Box
product.body_html:
The Norix Ironman Tank Box Property Storage Box gives correctional facilities a tough, easy-to-clean place to keep inmate belongings and records. Each box is injection molded from structural polyethylene, so it resists impact and will not rust. Full-height ribs molded into the walls and a thick top flange keep the box rigid, and it has passed a 3,000 lb static load test.

Tank Boxes nest for stable stacking and can be used under the bunk on Norix under-bunk rails. The box ships without a lid. The matching Tank Box lid adds a locating feature for stacking and a hasp for locking.

  • Material: Injection-molded structural polyethylene, 100% recyclable
  • Construction: Full-height molded-in vertical ribs every 1-1/4” and a 1/2” × 7/8” top flange for strength and rigidity
  • Stacking: Boxes nest for stable stacking
  • Static Load: Minimum sustained static load of 3,000 lbs for 4 hours
  • Flammability Standards: California Technical Bulletin 133, UL 1056, and ASTM E1537
  • Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
  • Color: Raven (black)
  • Lid: Sold separately as the Norix Tank Box Lid
  • Under-Bunk Use: Use only Norix under-bunk rails, which are made to fit Tank Boxes
  • Made In: USA
  • Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
  • Intended Use: Indoor use only

Available Models and Options

  • PB150 – Legal/Letter: 20.3” W × 13.9” D × 11” H, 1.33 cu ft, 9.5 lbs (fits lid PBL401)
  • PB200 – Standard: 22.9” W × 17.4” D × 8.5” H, 1.36 cu ft, 9 lbs (fits lid PBL400)
  • PB300 – Large: 22.9” W × 17.4” D × 12.5” H, 2.08 cu ft, 12 lbs (fits lid PBL400)
  • PB350 – Extra Large: 33.9” W × 22.9” D × 11” H, 4 cu ft, 22.5 lbs (fits lid PBL402)

No assembly is required.

Applications

The Tank Box is made for allowable in-cell storage. With four sizes, from a legal/letter file box up to a 4 cubic foot extra-large box, facilities can choose the size that fits what each person is allowed to keep.

Typical applications include:

  • Prisons, jails, and detention centers
  • Allowable in-cell property storage, including under-bunk storage on Norix rails
  • Inmate records and personal property storage

About Norix Ironman Detention Series

The Norix Ironman Detention Series includes heavy-duty correctional furniture, fixtures, and equipment designed for prisons, jails, detention centers, and other secure environments. Ironman products emphasize durability, security-conscious design, and low-maintenance construction for demanding institutional use.

The Ironman Series includes:

  • Steel Bunks: Floor-mounted single and double bunks and wall-mounted bunks
  • Seating: Benches with cuff rings for intake and holding areas and floor-mount stools
  • Washroom Accessories: Stainless steel ADA shower seats, grab bars, toilet paper holders, and hooks
  • Property Storage: Tank Box and Citadel inmate property storage boxes with matching lids

About Norix Furniture

Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.
